content:
We are about a day away from Apple's "wonder and shine" event, where we expect to see six to nine brand-new shiny products unveiled.

The iPhone Ultra foldable will be the headline news, but of all the expected announcements, which one are you personally most looking forward to...?

At the very least, we expect Apple to announce six new products tomorrow, but if all the rumors are true, there could be as many as nine.

The iPhone Ultra will undoubtedly be the headline focus. It is Apple's first folding iPhone, a full seven years after Samsung pioneered this form factor. But with the expected price exceeding $2,000, and top-spec models reaching as high as $3,000, it certainly won't be the best-seller.

So of all the expected and possible product announcements, which one are you personally most looking forward to? After watching our video roundup, cast your vote, and share your thoughts in the comments below.
